Use admin keys on your server and search keys everywhere else. ZeroIndex uses bearer tokens. Send your key in the `Authorization` header of every request. ```bash curl https://api.zeroindex.test/v1/indexes \ -H "Authorization: Bearer zi_admin_4f8a2c91e7" ``` ## Header <Param
